To reach the 125-level limit, I need many nested isolates. The isolate characters are LRI (U+2066), RLI (U+2067), FSI (U+2068). Each nested isolate increments the isolate_level.

Let me construct an input with many nested LRI/RLI isolates. Let me write a Python script to generate such input and test it.
